native_wasm_backends.scope: Exact RGB565 frame and serialized-save agreement between this project's native and WASM implementations. This is not original-PC pixel equivalence or a browser-storage test.

host_performance.summary: In the clean serial whole-version comparison, warm merchant inventory is 18.8–19.6% lower per frame and card hover is 23.8–27.8% lower. Room open/setup/first render rises about 12% in the idle fixture, warm merchant ranged reads rise from about 4.0 KB to 5.1 KB per frame, and warmed details remain zero-I/O with modest timing changes in either direction.
host_performance.scope: Whole UI5 versus UI6 card/shop scene cost measured as unpaced host steady-clock intervals through production ranged FILE resource callbacks. These intervals are not process CPU time, displayed FPS, emulator speed, or physical-calculator timing.

firebird.note: Final ordinary runtime booted through OS/Documents on a fresh disposable NAND copy, continued the imported canonical save, restored Fast Mode, saved and exited to the OS, and read back identical save/preference files. The optional final debug runtime separately demonstrated keyboard aim/play, kill-to-loot, shop and reload without autosaving, but its interactive wrapper hit its wall deadline before clean exit. The dedicated report preserves that partial scope and an additional failed Ndless-installer attempt. No physical-device performance claim.

retained_failures_and_limits.detail: The initial GCC debug build rejection, old reward-oracle assumptions, delayed enemy-replacement geometry, and one-pixel authored-marker rounding failures remain historical failures. Subsequent frozen code and corrected behavior assertions passed their stated gates.

The full run passed 78 cases and left one NotRun because its built file lacked executable permission. Only that file mode was repaired; the logged retry passed. This is not presented as an uninterrupted 79/79 first run.

Ten deck-icon frames differed after native App reconstruction because static HUD motion survived address/generation reuse. Both App::init overloads now reset the motion; the final stage-8 matrices reran all frames and saves without tolerances.

The full local sanitizer run remains recorded as 76 passed and 1 failed (77 total). Stage 8 uses unsigned bounded gear multiplication, saturates the held-button interpolation before multiplication and reduces full turns before phase conversion. Targeted local actual-pack checks and the independent complete CI sanitizer gate passed.

The first completed 12-run matrix (acfa5b72dcbd) placed the idle pointer over Burning Blood, obscuring inventory with a tooltip. Its data are excluded. A driver-only checkpoint moved the pointer to a verified empty target and repeated the complete serial matrix for both versions.

Ordinary stage-7 artifacts matched stage 6 exactly. Stage 8 changes HUD arithmetic, so final stage-8 builds, browser acceptance and complete backend replays supply their own evidence instead of inheriting the older binary hashes.
